name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
shortDescription: Enables Claude, Cursor, and AI agents to securely query PostgreSQL databases, inspect schemas, and execute read-only or read-write SQL analytics.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
In modern software engineering and data analytics, developers and business analysts frequently need to inspect database tables, diagnose data anomalies, write complex multi-table joins, and extract reporting metrics. Traditional workflows require switching between database GUIs (e.g. pgAdmin, DBeaver) and AI assistants, manually copying schema definitions and SQL queries back and forth.

The PostgreSQL MCP Server establishes a direct, standardized Model Context Protocol bridge between your PostgreSQL database and AI agents (such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, or autonomous pipelines). The LLM can directly inspect schemas, explore table relationships, run sanitized parameterized queries, and explain performance execution plans without exposing raw database passwords to third-party clouds.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Automated Root-Cause Analysis:** When an incident occurs, an AI agent queries error log tables, correlates timestamps with user IDs, and identifies faulty database rows.
- **Zero-Code Ad-Hoc Reporting:** Marketing and finance teams ask natural-language questions like *"Show monthly recurring revenue churn by country for Q3"*, and the agent automatically formulates and executes the SQL query.
- **Schema Migrations & Refactoring:** The agent inspects existing table indices and foreign keys, suggesting optimized indexes to eliminate full table scans.

toolsProvided.name: read_query
toolsProvided.description: Executes a read-only SELECT SQL query and returns rows in JSON format.

toolsProvided.name: write_query
toolsProvided.description: Executes INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE statements.

toolsProvided.name: list_tables
toolsProvided.description: Lists all available tables and views in the connected schema.

toolsProvided.name: describe_table
toolsProvided.description: Returns table column names, data types, constraints, and index definitions.

installGuide:
### Quick Setup
1. Run via NPX:
```bash
npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/dbname
```
2. Add the JSON snippet to your Claude Desktop or Cursor configuration.
3. Restart your AI client to begin querying.

name: Local Filesystem MCP Server
shortDescription: Grants AI assistants secure, sandboxed access to read, write, search, and manage directories and files on your local computer.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Standard LLM web interfaces operate in isolated sandboxes with zero awareness of your local codebase, project files, or desktop documents. Manually uploading individual files or copying snippets is tedious, prone to truncation, and breaks contextual awareness.

The Filesystem MCP Server empowers AI agents to autonomously explore approved directories, view code files, search for symbols across whole repositories, and create or refactor project files directly on your local hard drive with strict directory-level security restrictions.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Whole-Codebase Refactoring:** Let the AI traverse nested project folders, update deprecated library imports across 50+ files, and verify syntax.
- **Automated Documentation Generation:** Point the assistant at your internal documents or source code to automatically synthesize READMEs, OpenAPI specs, and user guides.
- **Log & Diagnostic Analysis:** AI agents directly tail, filter, and summarize gigabyte-sized system log files stored on local disks.

toolsProvided.name: read_file
toolsProvided.description: Reads complete contents of a local file within permitted directories.

toolsProvided.name: write_file
toolsProvided.description: Creates or updates a file with specified content.

toolsProvided.name: list_directory
toolsProvided.description: Lists all files and subdirectories with sizes and metadata.

toolsProvided.name: search_files
toolsProvided.description: Recursively searches for filenames and directory patterns.

installGuide:
### Quick Setup
```bash
npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /path/to/allowed/directory
```
Specify permitted directories to ensure secure sandboxing.

name: GitHub MCP Server
shortDescription: Connects AI agents directly to GitHub API to search repositories, inspect commits, create branches, manage issues, and review pull requests.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Engineering teams waste hundreds of hours every quarter toggling between GitHub PR reviews, issue trackers, and coding assistants. Code reviews frequently miss subtle bugs, while issue triaging requires tedious manual cross-referencing of commit histories.

The GitHub MCP Server turns your AI agent into an automated engineering co-pilot connected directly to your GitHub organization. It can query file histories, inspect git diffs on open PRs, draft detailed code review comments, label triage tickets, and open pull requests with automated bug fixes.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Automated Pull Request Code Reviews:** Trigger an AI review when a PR is opened to analyze edge cases, security vulnerabilities, and style violations.
- **Smart Issue Triaging & Deduplication:** When a customer files a bug, the agent searches existing open and closed issues to prevent duplicates and points developers to the suspect commit.
- **Release Note Compilation:** The agent summarizes all merged PRs between two git tags into publication-ready changelogs.

toolsProvided.name: get_file_contents
toolsProvided.description: Retrieves raw file contents from any branch in a GitHub repository.

toolsProvided.name: create_or_update_file
toolsProvided.description: Commits a file directly to a branch on GitHub.

toolsProvided.name: create_pull_request
toolsProvided.description: Opens a new PR with title, body, and branch specs.

toolsProvided.name: search_repositories
toolsProvided.description: Searches GitHub repositories by stars, language, and topics.

installGuide:
### Quick Setup
1. Create a GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope.
2. Add the token to the env block in your MCP client config.
3. Run: `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github`.

The Brave Search MCP Server connects AI agents to Brave’s completely independent 10-billion-page web index. The AI can execute real-time searches, extract snippet citations, query local business information, and ground its answers in verified up-to-the-minute web data.

name: Puppeteer Headless Chrome MCP
shortDescription: Gives AI agents a live headless Chromium browser to navigate pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract JavaScript-rendered content.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Modern web applications rely heavily on client-side JavaScript (React, Vue, Angular, SPAs). Traditional HTTP fetch requests only download empty HTML boilerplate and fail to access interactive dashboards, paywalled views, or multi-step checkout flows.

The Puppeteer MCP Server equips AI models with a full headless Chrome instance. The agent can click interactive elements, type into search bars, submit forms, wait for AJAX network requests, extract deeply nested DOM elements, and capture full-page high-resolution screenshots for visual verification.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Automated Competitor Price Auditing:** Navigate dynamic e-commerce catalogs, select dropdown options, and extract rendered pricing.
- **End-to-End QA Testing:** Agents autonomously test user signup flows, validating that form errors trigger correctly and reporting visual regressions.
- **SPA Content Extraction:** Scrape single-page applications and client-side data dashboards that require JavaScript execution.

name: Memory Graph MCP Server
shortDescription: Provides open-ended persistent long-term memory for AI assistants using a local knowledge graph of entities, relations, and observations.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Every time you start a new conversation with an LLM, it forgets everything you previously discussed: your coding style preferences, your infrastructure architecture, team names, API design guidelines, and personal constraints. Users waste valuable time repeatedly re-explaining the same context.

The Memory Graph MCP Server equips AI assistants with durable, persistent long-term memory stored on your local disk as an entity-relationship knowledge graph. Whenever you teach the AI something new, it creates entities and relations that persist across restarts and subsequent sessions.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Personalized Pair-Programming:** The AI remembers your preferred variable naming conventions, directory patterns, and forbidden third-party packages.
- **Multi-Session Project Planning:** Maintain architectural roadmaps across weeks of iterative development without losing context.
- **Customer Relationship Context:** Record customer preferences and organizational hierarchies that persist across support tickets.

toolsProvided.description: Stores new conceptual entities with names, types, and observational notes.

toolsProvided.name: create_relations

toolsProvided.name: open_nodes
toolsProvided.description: Retrieves knowledge graph nodes and connected relationship paths.

toolsProvided.name: search_nodes
toolsProvided.description: Searches the knowledge graph using fuzzy keyword matching.

installGuide:


The SQLite MCP Server allows LLMs to connect directly to any local .sqlite or .db file. It automatically introspects tables, analyzes row counts, crafts efficient queries, and visualizes summary trends for analytics, debugging, and migration tasks.

name: Docker DevOps MCP Server
shortDescription: Empowers AI models to inspect Docker containers, read runtime logs, manage container lifecycles, and diagnose containerized environments.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Diagnosing failures across multi-container Docker Compose stacks requires executing endless commands: docker ps, docker logs --tail, docker inspect, and docker stats. Developers often get lost in massive log outputs trying to pinpoint why a microservice crashed.

The Docker MCP Server provides an intelligent interface to your local or remote Docker daemon. The AI assistant can inspect running containers, query recent log streams, identify out-of-memory (OOM) kill events, analyze network port bindings, and restart failed containers autonomously.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Automated Container Crash Debugging:** When a local service fails, the AI inspects the exit code, reads the tail logs, identifies the missing environment variable, and suggests the exact fix.
- **Resource Leak Detection:** Continuously monitor container memory and CPU usage to detect memory leaks before crashes occur.
- **Environment Bootstrap Verification:** Ensure all database, Redis, and message broker containers are healthy before running integration test suites.

name: Sequential Thinking Deep Reasoning MCP
shortDescription: Dynamic step-by-step reasoning server that enables AI models to formulate multi-stage thought branches, revise hypotheses, and solve deep technical problems.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Standard LLMs often rush to generate code or answers on the first pass, leading to premature assumptions, architectural dead ends, and overlooked edge cases on complex multi-step engineering challenges.

The Sequential Thinking MCP Server gives AI assistants an explicit, multi-turn reasoning sandbox. The model can decompose complex problems into discrete thought steps, branch into exploratory hypotheses, score confidence levels, verify intermediate conclusions, and revise earlier thinking before presenting the final verified solution.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Complex Distributed System Design:** Map out failover modes, consensus protocols, and latency bottlenecks before writing architecture specs.
- **Subtle Bug Diagnosis:** Systematically eliminate candidate causes for race conditions and memory leaks.
- **Refactoring Strategy:** Plan dependency graphs and migration phases for multi-module codebases.

name: Ollama: Run LLMs Locally
shortDescription: Get up and running with Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-R1, Mistral, and other large language models locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows with zero setup.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Organizations are frequently barred from using cloud LLM APIs due to strict data privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2), data sovereignty mandates, or costly token billing at scale.

Ollama democratizes local AI by packaging model weights, configuration, and GPU acceleration into a single seamless binary. With one terminal command, developers can download and run multi-gigabyte models with full hardware optimization for Apple Silicon Metal, NVIDIA CUDA, and AMD ROCm.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **100% Private Offline Inference:** Process confidential medical, legal, or financial documents without a single byte leaving the premises.
- **Local Coding Assistant:** Pair with Continue.dev or Cursor to autocomplete code entirely offline on your laptop.
- **Cost-Free Development Sandbox:** Run millions of development and testing prompts without racking up API expenses.

name: vLLM: High-Throughput LLM Serving
shortDescription: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs with PagedAttention, continuous batching, and OpenAI-compatible API.
fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Serving production LLMs at scale is notoriously expensive. GPU memory (VRAM) is quickly exhausted by key-value (KV) cache fragmentation, capping throughput at a fraction of theoretical hardware capacity.

vLLM introduces PagedAttention, an algorithm inspired by virtual memory paging in operating systems that eliminates KV cache fragmentation. It delivers 2x to 4x higher throughput than standard serving frameworks while providing a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI API format.

### Practical Enterprise Workflows
- **Enterprise Private AI Gateway:** Host an OpenAI-compatible API on your own Kubernetes clusters serving hundreds of concurrent employees.
- **High-Volume Batch Processing:** Process millions of categorization or summarization jobs at maximum GPU utilization.
- **Custom Fine-Tuned Model Deployment:** Serve proprietary fine-tuned weights with multi-LoRA support.

toolsProvided.name: vllm_serve
toolsProvided.description: Launches OpenAI-compatible HTTP server on port 8000.

installGuide:
### Quick Setup
```bash
pip install vllm
vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
```

LangChain provides standardized abstractions (LangChain Expression Language - LCEL) to connect language models to data sources and execution environments. It simplifies Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), structured data extraction, and multi-agent coordination.

- **Multi-Tool Autonomous Agents:** Equip models with Google Search, calculators, and API callers to accomplish complex tasks.

name: CrewAI: Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework

fullUseCase:
### Executive Problem & Solution
Single AI prompts struggle with multi-stage projects that require distinct skillsets: research, synthesis, critique, formatting, and verification. Individual agents attempt to do everything at once and produce shallow or generic results.

CrewAI allows developers to assemble crews of specialized agents with distinct personas, goals, backstories, and dedicated toolsets. Agents collaborate synchronously or asynchronously, handing off intermediate artifacts like a real human team.

- **Financial Due Diligence:** Crew with a Market Researcher, a Regulatory Compliance Auditor, and an Investment Memo Writer.
- **Content Marketing Pipeline:** Research agent crawls breaking trends, writer agent drafts long-form copy, and editor agent audits tone and facts.
- **Automated Bug Triage & Patching:** Triager isolates stack traces, coder writes git diff, and QA agent runs unit tests.
